title.narrative: Support to UNFPA for the Procurement of Medical Equipment for Adolescent-Friendly Health Service Centres in Honduras

description.narrative: The purpose of this project is to strengthen and equip Adolescent-Friendly Health Services centres in Honduras, expanding access to quality sexual and reproductive health services for adolescents. This strengthening includes the purchase of medical equipment, medical-surgical instruments, furniture, technological equipment, medical supplies, and for the improvement of existing clinics and the Ciudad Mujer clinics. This initiative seeks to reduce the high rates of teenage pregnancy and child marriage in the country by providing adolescents with access to adequate health services and promoting sexual and reproductive health education.
